about: memory.mts --budgets for the low-memory setup (?lowmem=1&geofree=1&farimp=1, the whole island) on SwiftShader: one practice match, sampled at the playable title, as the plane phase starts, and 60 s into the play phase. CI's no-GPU low-memory memory job runs it. A number over its budget fails; a number more than underPct under fails until the budget is lowered (the failure names the new value, measured plus headroomPct), so budgets only go down. residentPois counts the built POI modules, the lobby islet included; peakResidentPois is the most there were at once (polled every 250 ms), which is the cap (lowmemcap 3) plus the islet: it fails over if eviction stops holding the cap and under if nothing streams. Only numbers that repeat between runner instances are budgeted. After the title, which POI is mid-build at the sample varies: between runs the plane moved CPU copies by 50-80 MB and the JS heap 207.0-220.0 MB, and the match moved textures 493-570, geometry CPU copies 279.0-319.8 MB, texture CPU copies 222.8-249.9 MB and evictions 1-2, so those are recorded in result.json but not budgeted. Set 2026-11-07 from five runs on the CI runner (three in run 42331517673 at b62ff65, one each in runs 42332717104 at dae40d3 and 42333659158 at d95771c, all on main 4548a29). Title: WebGL 1312.6-1323.3 MB, textures 243-244, geometry CPU 118.9-119.9 MB, texture CPU 268.6 MB, JS heap 179.0-179.6 MB. Plane: WebGL 2066.3-2073.4 MB, textures 498-500. Match: WebGL 2115.8-2146.3 MB, JS heap 221.7-222.9 MB, 4 resident POIs (peak 4) in every run. Each MB and texture budget is the largest run plus 2%, rounded up; the POI counts are the measured value, exactly. The title JS heap (sampled after two forced GCs 1.5 s apart) is 177.7 MB in three reruns of main bb72aa79 on the CI runner and 186.8-194.7 MB in two attempts of the sync PR head 6483f1cf, so its budget was the largest reading rounded up to 195 with a 12% floor; 36 CI jobs on 2026-11-08 between 08:00 and 10:32 UTC (same runner image 20261028.624, same Playwright chromium-1248) then read 177.3-200.5 MB, so it is the largest reading plus 2%, rounded up (205), with a 15% floor. The title geometry CPU copies read 118.1-118.9 MB in 33 of those jobs and 109.5-110.8 MB in 3 (main a6ac0b0a, #338, #339): the 17 far impostors (about 8 MB of CPU geometry, which geofree does not drop) load from the 2 s low-memory trim timer after ready, and since the title sample is taken at ready (#210) it sometimes lands before they do, so geometryCpuMB keeps its 123 MB budget with a 12% floor; the title texture count read 236, 238, 238 on bb72aa79 and 244 in this PR's own run, so its budget stays 249 and its floor is 8% under. The match WebGL floor is 10% under (underPctBy): which POIs are resident 60 s in moves its WebGL total by about 4% between runs (2060.6-2147 MB over seven CI runs, #289's 2060.6 MB at the same 4 resident POIs as main), so the default 5% floor failed on spread alone; its ceiling is unchanged.
